name: Hardcoded Credentials
summary: Adversaries may leverage credentials that are hardcoded in software or firmware to gain an unauthorized interactive user session to an asset. Examples credentials that may be hardcoded in an asset include: * Username/Passwords * Cryptographic keys/Certificates * API tokens Unlike Default Credentials, these credentials are built into the system in a way that they either cannot be changed by the asset owner, or may be infeasible to change because…

analytics.name: Analytic 1930
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies field device access using credentials matching hardcoded values extracted from Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor firmware or configuration files, from a source with no legitimate operational role. Documented in TriStation 1131 v4.9.0 and earlier, which contained undocumented power-user accounts with hardcoded credentials. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass…
